_refused: dcsaudio.com's Terms of Use, READ IN A BROWSER on 2026-11-25 at https://dcsaudio.com/terms, forbid this outright under its own heading « No text or data mining, or web scraping »: « You shall not conduct, facilitate, authorise or permit any text or data mining or web scraping in relation to our site or any services provided via, or in relation to, our site. This includes using (or permitting, authorising or attempting the use of): Any "robot", "bot", "spider", "scraper" or other automated device, program, tool, algorithm, code, process or methodology to access, obtain, copy, monitor or republish any portion of the site or any data, content, information or services accessed via the same. [...] The provisions in this clause should be treated as an express reservation of our rights in this regard, including for the purposes of Article 4(3) of Digital Copyright Directive ((EU) 2019/790). » A second clause forbids the use regardless of how the content was obtained: « Our site is for personal and domestic use and you must not use any part of the content on our site for commercial or business purposes without obtaining a licence to do so from us or our licensors. » No record will exist under this brand. Varese, Vivaldi APEX, Rossini APEX, Bartok APEX and Lina DAC X were listed on the home page and NOT read.
_the_403_was_the_answer_after_all: This brand was recorded on 2026-11-25 as unanswered because the fetcher got 403 and the rule is that an unverified question is not a permission. The browser answered it the same day: forbidden, in the plainest words in this register. The 403 comes from Cloudflare - the cookie policy names « cf_clearance » and says « Cloudflare protects this site against automated attacks » - so the block and the clause are one policy, the machine enforcing what the lawyer wrote. What this does NOT show is that a 403 means refusal: Devialet and Yamaha also blocked the fetcher, were also read in a browser, and are also in this register, while other blocked hosts permitted. The browser answers the question; the block never does. An earlier draft of this very note claimed Devialet and Yamaha « turned out to permit », which is the opposite of what the register says - written from memory instead of from the file, and corrected the same hour.
